## Checklist

- [ ] `envy-wallpaper check` says the folder is fit to publish.
- [ ] It is my own work, or I have the right to license it as its `wallpaper.toml` says.
- [ ] It holds no one else's characters, logos or trademarks.
- [ ] It suits a living room.
- [ ] A changed wallpaper has a higher `version`.
